findings.summary: Unused next/font loading emitted blocked local module requests
findings.resolution: Removed the unused loader and font variables, then added route-wide browser exception and console-error assertions.

findings.summary: The live public origins do not expose the complete reviewed launch route/redirect/sitemap surface
evidence: two V2 tokenomics redirects target archive-record
findings.remediation: Use a separately authorized deployment/reconciliation workflow, then rerun the read-only public contract check.

findings.summary: Turkish public metadata is not at fluent bilingual parity and the title contract needs reconciliation
evidence: Turkish root served the English brand title
multiple Turkish route titles were visibly mistranslated
38 title/description mismatches include both real defects and route-specific-title policy differences
findings.remediation: Reconcile the intended metadata contract and obtain fluent Turkish human review before publishing a bilingual parity claim.

findings.summary: The isolated admin bundle retains browser-externalized Node imports and a large output chunk
evidence: largest chunk approximately 2148.15 kB and 487.84 kB gzip
findings.remediation: Prove the built localhost console in an isolated non-signing runtime and reduce or document the dependency surface before ceremony use.

findings.summary: Development tooling retains upstream advisories while production dependencies are clear
findings.remediation: Review non-breaking upstream resolutions and reproduce every launch gate before accepting toolchain changes.

findings.summary: Physical-device, graphical Linux, assistive-technology, performance-lab, and independent QA coverage is unavailable
findings.remediation: Run and publish the matrix in the missing environments with independent review.
